transcript: Speaker A: With Flow, I can just stream my consciousness directly into all of these LLMs and I don't lose any of my immediate thoughts. But I can only type at realistically maybe 60 to 70 words per minute, and I'm not 100% accurate. I make mistakes, and especially when I'm prompting, I find that I type even a little bit slower because I have to think more carefully and then I have to kind of remember what I thought about and type it into the computer. But I can speak pretty fast, right? So watch, if I go to Flow: 'Hey, can you change the name of my application to be DevLaunch Vault?' And it'll pick it up, and boom, it puts it in there.
summary: The presenter demonstrates 'Flow', a tool for dictating prompts directly into LLMs. He compares slow typing speeds with fast voice dictation, showing a live demo of the tool in action.
